highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 incorporates four upstream m150 synchronization rounds, including targeted Ganesh stability fixes.
highlights_body: The updates prevent stale GPU readbacks and improve cleanup when a Ganesh resolve task cannot execute.

bullets.lead: Four m150 engine fix rounds integrated
bullets.detail: Updates the release line through four upstream sync rounds, including targeted Ganesh work that prevents stale readbacks and unwinds failed resolve tasks.

harfbuzz_summary: Advances the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package to 14.2.1.2 with no HarfBuzz binding changes.
